SELECT ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS overall_fare_per_km, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS overall_avg_booking, ROUND(AVG("Ride Distance"), 2) AS overall_avg_distance, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS overall_total_earnings, COUNT(*) AS completed_rides FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed'

SELECT "Driver Ratings", COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking_value, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS total_earnings FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY "Driver Ratings" ORDER BY "Driver Ratings"

SELECT MIN("Driver Ratings") AS min_r, MAX("Driver Ratings") AS max_r, ROUND(AVG("Driver Ratings"), 2) AS avg_r, MIN("Booking Value") AS min_bv, MAX("Booking Value") AS max_bv, MIN("Ride Distance") AS min_d, MAX("Ride Distance") AS max_d FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed'

SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING("Time", 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking_value, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS total_earnings FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day

SELECT "Payment Method", COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking_value, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY "Payment Method" ORDER BY ride_count DESC

SELECT CAST(STRFTIME('%w', "Date") AS INTEGER) AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking_value, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS total_earnings FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week

SELECT CAST(STRFTIME('%m', "Date") AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking_value, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS total_earnings FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", 6, INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') - 1) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking_value, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS total_earnings FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%w', SUBSTRING("Date", 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTRING("Date", 6, INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') - 1) || '-' || SUBSTRING("Date", INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') + 6)) IS NULL THEN 'unparsed' ELSE 'parsed' END AS parse_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY parse_status

SELECT STRFTIME('%w', SUBSTRING("Date", 1, 4) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", 6, INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') - 1) AS INTEGER)) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') + 6) AS INTEGER))) AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking_value, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS total_earnings FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week

SELECT CASE WHEN "Ride Distance" <= 5 THEN '0-5 km' WHEN "Ride Distance" <= 10 THEN '5-10 km' WHEN "Ride Distance" <= 15 THEN '10-15 km' WHEN "Ride Distance" <= 20 THEN '15-20 km' WHEN "Ride Distance" <= 25 THEN '20-25 km' WHEN "Ride Distance" <= 30 THEN '25-30 km' WHEN "Ride Distance" <= 40 THEN '30-40 km' ELSE '40+ km' END AS distance_band, COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking_value, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY distance_band ORDER BY MIN("Ride Distance")

SELECT CASE WHEN "Driver Ratings" < 3.5 THEN '3.0-3.4' WHEN "Driver Ratings" < 4.0 THEN '3.5-3.9' WHEN "Driver Ratings" < 4.5 THEN '4.0-4.4' ELSE '4.5-5.0' END AS rating_band, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS total_earnings FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY rating_band ORDER BY MIN("Driver Ratings")

SELECT "Pickup Location", COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS total_earnings FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY "Pickup Location" ORDER BY ride_count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT CASE WHEN "Voice Talk Average Time" < 5 THEN '0-5 min' WHEN "Voice Talk Average Time" < 10 THEN '5-10 min' WHEN "Voice Talk Average Time" < 15 THEN '10-15 min' ELSE '15+ min' END AS voice_band, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(AVG("Driver Ratings"), 2) AS avg_driver_rating FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY voice_band ORDER BY MIN("Voice Talk Average Time")

SELECT CASE WHEN "Customer Technical Assistance Time" < 5 THEN '0-5 min' WHEN "Customer Technical Assistance Time" < 10 THEN '5-10 min' WHEN "Customer Technical Assistance Time" < 15 THEN '10-15 min' ELSE '15+ min' END AS assist_band, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(AVG("Driver Ratings"), 2) AS avg_driver_rating FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY assist_band ORDER BY MIN("Customer Technical Assistance Time")

SELECT MIN("Customer Technical Assistance Time") AS min_ctat, MAX("Customer Technical Assistance Time") AS max_ctat, ROUND(AVG("Customer Technical Assistance Time"), 2) AS avg_ctat FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed'
SELECT DISTINCT "Customer Technical Assistance Time" FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' ORDER BY "Customer Technical Assistance Time" LIMIT 20

SELECT CASE WHEN "Customer Technical Assistance Time" < 20 THEN '15-20 min' WHEN "Customer Technical Assistance Time" < 25 THEN '20-25 min' WHEN "Customer Technical Assistance Time" < 30 THEN '25-30 min' WHEN "Customer Technical Assistance Time" < 35 THEN '30-35 min' ELSE '35+ min' END AS assist_band, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(AVG("Driver Ratings"), 2) AS avg_driver_rating FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY assist_band ORDER BY MIN("Customer Technical Assistance Time")

SELECT "Vehicle Type", "Booking Value", "Ride Distance", "Driver Ratings", "Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0) AS fare_per_km, STRFTIME('%w', SUBSTRING("Date", 1, 4) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", 6, INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') - 1) AS INTEGER)) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') + 6) AS INTEGER))) AS day_of_week, CAST(SUBSTRING("Time", 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS hour FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed'

SELECT "Vehicle Type", "Booking Value", "Ride Distance", "Driver Ratings", "Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0) AS fare_per_km, STRFTIME('%w', SUBSTRING("Date", 1, 4) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", 6, INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') - 1) AS INTEGER)) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') + 6) AS INTEGER))) AS day_of_week, CAST(SUBSTRING("Time", 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS hour FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed'

SELECT "Vehicle Type", "Booking Value", "Ride Distance", "Driver Ratings", "Pickup Location", "Drop Location", "Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0) AS fare_per_km, STRFTIME('%w', SUBSTRING("Date", 1, 4) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", 6, INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') - 1) AS INTEGER)) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') + 6) AS INTEGER))) AS day_of_week, CAST(SUBSTRING("Time", 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS hour FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed'

SELECT "Vehicle Type", ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking, ROUND(AVG("Ride Distance"), 2) AS avg_dist, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 2) AS total_earnings, COUNT(*) AS completed_rides FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY "Vehicle Type" ORDER BY total_earnings DESC

SELECT "Vehicle Type", "Booking Value", "Ride Distance", "Driver Ratings", "Pickup Location", "Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0) AS fare_per_km, STRFTIME('%w', SUBSTRING("Date", 1, 4) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", 6, INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') - 1) AS INTEGER)) || '-' || PRINTF('%02d', CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') + 6) AS INTEGER))) AS day_of_week FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed'

SELECT "Pickup Location" || ' → ' || "Drop Location" AS route, COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km, ROUND(AVG("Ride Distance"), 2) AS avg_distance FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY route HAVING ride_count >= 100 ORDER BY avg_fare_per_km DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT "Drop Location", COUNT(*) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS avg_fare_per_km FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY "Drop Location" ORDER BY avg_fare_per_km DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING("Date", 6, INSTR(SUBSTRING("Date", 6), '/') - 1) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value"), 2) AS avg_booking, ROUND(AVG("Booking Value" / NULLIF("Ride Distance", 0)), 2) AS fare_per_km, ROUND(SUM("Booking Value"), 0) AS total_earnings FROM temp.reuse_candidate AS sheet1 WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
DROP TABLE temp.reuse_candidate
